group_note: 逸俠之世界 (Daniel's World), ES II lineage, Taiwan-origin. Close sibling of libs/yxsj (same title, same daniel@tpts4.seed.net.tw contact, same is_killing/check_legal_name bug fingerprint, same file layout) but confirmed NOT a byte-identical duplicate -- content differs even after normalizing whitespace/CRLF (e.g. adm/daemons/combatd.lpc differs by ~80 lines), and this snapshot already had securityd.lpc's save_object() path fixed (query_save_file()+__SAVE_EXTENSION__) where yxsj's needed that fix applied -- a different point-in-time build, not a repackaged archive of the same file set. Same MAJOR encoding bug as yxsj found and fixed first: this archive is also BIG5-encoded but the initial convert_lib.sh pass used the corpus-wide GB18030 default, producing silent mojibake (valid UTF-8, real-but-wrong CJK codepoints) rather than a conversion error. Re-ran convert_lib.sh with BIG5 (see the extended-tooling commit made while processing yxsj) and redid every fix against the freshly-converted tree. WASM-specific fixes applied (identical pattern to yxsj): (1) classic §8.1 is_chinese()/check_legal_name() byte-range bug, per-codepoint 0x4e00-0x9fff, bounds halved 2/12->1/6. (2) §7.12 tell_room() bare-exclude message() crash, exclude || ({}) guard. (3) master.lpc valid_write() missing 'user == this_object()' guard (valid_read() already unconditionally returns 1; securityd.lpc's save_object() check was already correct in this snapshot, unlike yxsj). (4) §7.50 is_killing(object) vs is_killing(string id) fixed at the same 9 call sites as yxsj (kungfu class roar/nuke files, u/d/daniel/ NPC files, cmds/std/surrender.lpc). (5) 45 CRLF .o save files under data/ normalized to LF. adm/daemons/ftpd.lpc and adm/daemons/network/dns_master.lpc both dormant (commented out of preload, only guarded wizard-command callers), left untouched. Same known non-blocking issues as yxsj, not chased down further: chinesed.lpc/emoted.lpc both throw a caught 'Illegal mapping format while restoring dict/emote' at boot; a transient 'apply() with insufficient permission... needs: private, has: hidden' for obj/user's command_hook appears during login but doesn't block anything. Admin seeded: fluffos (admin) in adm/etc/wizlist. Registration verified end-to-end pre- and post-formatter with a real Chinese name; admin permission confirmed via '目前權限﹕(admin)'. LPC formatter run across all 949 .lpc files (919 written, 21 pre-existing errors, 9 unchanged) -- numbers identical to yxsj, consistent with these being closely-related snapshots of the same codebase.
